question: 按税务状态统计 2016 年交易额，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT da.TaxStatus AS taxstatus, SUM(ft.Quantity * ft.TradePrice) AS total_trade_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_account da ON ft.SK_AccountID = da.SK_AccountID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2016 GROUP BY da.TaxStatus ORDER BY total_trade_value DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 交易额以货币金额度量
税务状态是经纪账户的属性(0/1/2)
